photography: No photography of people. Abstract 3D renders and generative/AI visuals only: glowing gradient S-mark on a pedestal, neural network node graphs, holographic geometric grids, silhouette-in-portal compositions. Consistent blue-cyan-violet gradient lighting.
density: Medium density bento-style grid of feature tiles and stat cards; confident whitespace between marketing sections; interactive/data panels are denser and functional.
card_style: Rounded tiles (12-16px radius) with a small icon chip, short title, and one line of support copy; consistent icon-tile pattern across feature grids.
spacing_style: Medium density bento-style grid of feature tiles and stat cards; confident whitespace between marketing sections; interactive/data panels are denser and functional.
icon_style: Lucide-style outline icons, 1.75px-2px stroke, rounded joins, no fill except active/selected states.
color_temperature: cool — blue/cyan/violet gradient family on near-white (light) or deep navy (dark)
editorial_feel: Friendly, modern, AI-forward, confident but approachable.
